source.entry: 2026-09-17 — overseer-b97-aebq: interrupting a review round moves work away from landing
source.quote: When a review round's findings are not defects — a verdict the critic could not record, a report that contains no defect — do not interrupt the worker that was re-dispatched. Let the rounds finish so the bead reaches `awaits a decision`, then put the reviewer's verdict to the user and land it with `accept_review`.

input:
